units: Accuracy, template_macro_f1 and invalid_rate are fractions; differences are percentage points.
metrics_definition: Strict generated-answer metrics; macro-F1 is averaged over question templates. Selection is diagnostic option-NLL for original arms and generated-answer calibration for exposure_matched; it is not interchangeable with held-out generation.

generated.draw_hash_format: UTF-8 json.dumps(task_id) plus LF, concatenated in draw order

original.draw_hash_format: UTF-8 json.dumps(task_id) plus LF, concatenated in draw order

caveats: Primary checkpoint is fixed at update 12,000 to match baseline selected exposure; diagnostic selection cannot choose an earlier checkpoint.
Original row order, 192,000 original draws and the 15,531-step LR chronology match baseline. Effective batch is 18 (16 original +2 generated), versus baseline 16.
The new arm adds only frozen DiffuSETS QA to baseline. Comparisons with prior grounded/acquisition stacks change both the data mix and sampling/checkpoint policy.
This is an exploratory single-seed ablation designed after earlier held-out results were known. No across-seed uncertainty is available.
